entries.subject: JWST observations of 2002AW197 (programme 1191)
entries.finding: JWST observed 2002AW197 in programme 1191 (NIRSpec IFU), a reflectance spectrum. The body is far smaller than JWST's resolution at its distance, so these give composition, not a resolved disc, shape or map. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
